items.item_text: Most possess and maintain a current Registered Nurse (RN) license with the state of California.
Must possess and maintain a current Basic Life Support (BLS) certificate.
Must possess and maintain a current Advanced Critical Life Support (ACLS) certificate at the time of employment and or transfer.
Must possess and maintain a current Pediatrics Advance Life Support (PALS) or Emergency Nurse Pediatrics Certified (ENPC) certificate at the time of employment or transfer
Previous acute or emergency experience a plus

Patient Rights and Advocacy involves respecting and accommodating the patient’s cultural, linguistic, religious, and family needs by utilizing professional interpreters and ensuring that Advance Directives are addressed

Comprehensive Assessment requires the nurse to perform and document timely, age-appropriate, and holistic patient assessments including risks for falls, skin integrity, nutrition, and abuse at a ninety-five (95) percent compliance rate

Collaborative Care Planning entails the development and consistent updating of individualized, multidisciplinary plans of care that define clear nursing goals and interventions tailored to the patient’s specific developmental stage and needs

Safe and Effective Implementation involves executing nursing interventions, hourly rounds, and physician orders in strict accordance with facility policies while prioritizing patient safety and clear communication with the healthcare team

Continuous Evaluation and Documentation requires the nurse to actively monitor patient progress and post-procedure status by updating care plans every shift and maintaining accurate, complete medical records to ensure high-quality and complaint-free care

Competency Assurance involves maintaining and demonstrating ongoing developmental, cultural, and linguistic proficiency through direct observation, consistent auditing of medical records, and strict adherence to all facility policies and legal standards
Trauma Nurse Core Course (TNCC), within 18 months
